title: EDG Community Update: July 11th, 2022
body:
**Highlights**
- [Edgeverse Wallet by Bharathcoorg](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1547657319890030592?s=20&t=IQmbeWR1AZ9AukEYerKLrQ) supporting Edgeware solochain, Beresheet testnet, Kabocha parahchain, Soupcan testnet and Pop-Art relaychain testnet is now available for android devices on the Google Play Store.
- [The Twitter Meme Competition](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1546164048013787136?s=20&t=hIDnxvlcPCXR6F-sM0XLpw) aka campaign 2 from The Cutting Edge Conquest series has been extended by two more days until 6 pm UTC on 20th July.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP5/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP5/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Upcoming Activities: The Cutting Edge Conquest campaigns, Kabocha’s Technical AMA ft. Ramsey and Rusty Crewmates, Kabocha’s Community Mods Onboarding Quiz


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Richard aka monsieurbulb [reintroduced the Edgeware ecosystem to the Kusama community](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1547591705704050689?s=20&t=IQmbeWR1AZ9AukEYerKLrQ).
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-july-10/)’.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcomed to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community
